q: Which of these events took place in 1920?
the creation of the League of Nations
the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand at Sarajevo
The creation of the League of Nations : 1920.
In which year did the outbreak of the Boer War take place?
The outbreak of the Boer War : 1899.
Which of these events took place in 1885?
the independence of Angola and Mozambique
the independence of the Belgian Congo
the signing of the General Act of the Berlin Conference
the passing of the Defferre Framework Law
The signing of the General Act of the Berlin Conference : 1885.
What happened in Cameroon on 20 May 1972?
A referendum created the United Republic of Cameroon
That is why 20 May is the National Day.

Adolf Hitler becoming Chancellor of Germany
the proclamation of the First French Republic
the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor
Which revolution, led by Lenin's Bolsheviks, took place in 1917?
It led to the creation of the Soviet Union.

the placing of Cameroon under UN trusteeship
the German–Duala treaty that began the German protectorate of Kamerun
the return to the name 'Republic of Cameroon'
the German defeat in Cameroon and its partition between France and Britain
The German defeat in Cameroon and its partition between France and Britain : 1916.
